reviews.text:
Extremely disappointed with this company’s replaster job and how they treat their customers. What should have been a professional upgrade turned into a frustrating and stressful experience.

From the start, the Bond Kote prep was a mess. They applied a thin, splattered layer with large areas of old plaster showing through. Hugo, the project manager, insisted this was how they do all their jobs, even though the manufacturer requires full coverage at 80 mil thickness. I contacted the plaster manufacturer with photos, and they confirmed the prep would void the warranty. Only after I threatened to walk away did Hugo agree to redo it properly.

I also mentioned a known pool leak and asked to upgrade the pool light from day one. Both were ignored until it was too late. By the time they addressed the light, the second coat of Bond Kote was already applied. Their electrician told me it was “too much work” to cut and reapply, and quoted me double what other companies charge just to shut me up.
In the end, they capped the old light niche, and now I have no pool light at all and have to return pool light I was hoping to install.

The leak was also ignored until after plaster was done. Once they finally checked it, they found the third return jet pipe was cracked. Fixing it would mean drilling through brand-new plaster—too costly and unrealistic and I had to refuse. So now I’m stuck with just two return jets.

Both the light and leak should have been addressed on day one. Instead, I was left with no light and a capped jet features that were part of the original plan.

Finally they applied and polished the plaster in 100°F heat with no shade, against manufacturer recommendations. I asked them not to acid wash, but multiple people insisted it was part of their process, one guy called me and said they have to do it. The dry plaster absorbed the acid unevenly, leaving the surface dull, chalky, and colorless. Looks nothing like sample pictures.

This company ignored major issues, cut corners, and left me with a poor result. The plaster looks bad, and the pool is missing key features. I deeply regret trusting them. Avoid if you want the job done right.

I provided photos of their prep work, you can compare to Bond Kote videos of other pool companies vs what they gave me and my final plaster result.

reviews.text: Big talkers, no action. Early to mid-May of 2022, I contacted Pacific Pool Plaster to replaster and retile my pool. They told me the job would start shortly after Memorial Day. Tile samples were brought so I could decide which one I wanted. Around the time the job should have started, I called (so I could let them know which tile I wanted), left a message but they did not return my call. I family emergency hit our household and I was not able to deal with the pool for many weeks. I finally called them again in July. Naomi (the person that answers the phone) said she thought I did not want the job done. I have no clue where or how she got that idea, after all, I had called and was still waiting for a return call. I was very upset, the job should have been done by that point. The owner called me. I said not only did I want the pool replastered and retiled, I was now considering having the coping replaced. He said he would send his son out to look at it. The son came out that afternoon, looked at the pool and said the he or his dad would follow up. It is now January 2023, I still waiting to hear from them with a new quote. If you don't want to do the job, just say so but don't leave people hanging.  They are real good at sweet talk, but there are no results to show for it. You have been warned.

reviews.text:
If you need pool work done, don't look any further than this company-- They are AWESOME!  I had a slow leak in my pool all summer that accelerated over the past month.  I had to turn off the pool pump the Monday before Christmas because it was leaking so bad air started getting in the skimmers.  I contacted PPP and the owner came by within a couple days to assess the problem and make suggestions for repairs.  There was no "hard sell" and in the end I had them replaster the pool, replace the pool light, split the returns (skimmer vs bottom of pool) and move the pool pump to a cement slab because the previous owner of the house had it sitting in a mud pit!  The guys showed up early, worked late, cleaned up after themselves and did a really nice job.  I definitely recommend them to anyone who wants a new pool installed or needs plastering/work on their old pool!

UPDATE 4 FEB 2020:  Taking away 1 star because they did not install the "eyeballs" over the pool return feeds after doing the plaster and I've texted and left voice messages at least 4 times asking when that will be done but received no response.  I will give them another couple weeks to see if they come back to finish the job and either add or delete stars accordingly.

UPDATE 20 FEB 2020:  The owner was in the hospital, which is why he did not answer the phone. They came back and installed the eyeballs.   One of the skimmers was leaking and they fixed that too.  I am adding back the other star because he stands behind his work and he is very nice and concerned with doing a great job!
